# Design — public API surface for the loan crate

## L1 invariant

The public API surface MUST be limited to the types enumerated below. New `pub use` re-exports require an API-surface review and a SemVer-minor bump. Glob re-exports (`pub use foo::*;`) are forbidden — each re-export must enumerate the items.

## Public contract

Only these items may be reachable through the loan crate's `pub` tree:

- `pub struct LoanResponse { ... }`
- `pub enum LoanError { ... }`

Internal types (`InternalLoan`, `RawSnapshot`, `LedgerCursor`, etc.) MUST remain `pub(crate)`.

## Convention notes

- No glob re-exports.
- `#[non_exhaustive]` preserved on every public enum and struct.
